choices.content: The perpendicular segment is the shortest.
The interior angles of a triangle sum to \(180^\circ\).
Equal angles have equal opposite sides.
The line segment between two points is the shortest path.

question.prompt: When using reflection to solve shortest path problems, which basic fact is ultimately used?

solutions.explanation: After transforming the broken line \(A\text{-}P\text{-}B\) into \(A'\text{-}P\text{-}B\), the minimum is obtained using the fact that the line segment between two points is the shortest path.
solutions.title: Identify the shortest-path principle
